scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=web run typecheck && npm --prefix electron run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --workspace=server run build && npm --workspace=web run build
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run build
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -n server,web,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=web run dev" "npm --prefix electron run dev"
